confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors draw on several Florence cost-of-living and guide sources that broadly agree but differ in method, date and serving size; euro figures were converted at approximate mid-2026 rates. Meal and coffee anchors are the best supported; beer is less certain. Wine_glass comes from trattoria house-wine guide ranges (about EUR 3-7) and sits just below the beer anchor, following the local beer relationship, because no current restaurant-table price was confirmed. Cocktail reflects spritz-survey and classic-cocktail ranges, roughly twice the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic general-knowledge estimates for peak-July Florence; no live listings or booking pages were inspected, and rates vary widely by date and booking lead time. FX: 0.6976 is the RBA 4pm rate for 2026-11-03 as reported by a bestexchangerates.com article; the rba.gov.au exchange-rates page surfaced in search did not confirm it, and a later observation may exist, so treat it as provisional.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city proxy was used for food and drink; anchors rest on Florence-specific aggregated sources. Accommodation is a holistic general-knowledge estimate for Florence's peak-summer hotel market, not a lookup for another city.
